notes.title: NEW GAME - CYBORG3003 (Shadows of Kepler lives)
notes.notes:
Hello friends, if you follow me, you know that I'm still working with game development and now more than ever I want to put all my knowledge into a new game. I always did and do everything with a lot of energy and enthusiasm. But everything is a phase and this time is no different, I want to introduce you to a new game that I started in March of this year. Yes, is the same weapon of Shadows of Kepler. Is it you, Cooper?

Exactly 5 months later, I bring you the trailer and Steam page. It's a very similar game, but now a multiplayer co-op, with a lot of shooting and adrenaline, one of the genres I like the most, mixing sci-fi, monsters and aliens.

I invite you to visit the new site: www.cyborg3003.com It has all the links to the new social networks. 

And last, but not least, I will open vacancies for hiring and forming a great Cyborg3003 team, we will be a team with a single mission, to bring the best possible co-op game to the market. A big hug to all and let's go!

notes.title: It's all about passion and hard work
notes.notes:
Hi. This is Rodrigo, the developer of Shadows of Kepler. Due to the difficulties we had with the team, unfortunately we could not continue producing the game. On the other hand, I'm now on a life mission, with the game Parallel, where alone, I've been producing all the details of the game. I'll leave the latest video here for you to see, I still have a lot to improve and the plans are to launch the game in 2022.

[previewyoutube=CE0jHaxvzhE;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyone who can help, add the game to the Steam Wish List 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1388350/Parallel/

With the necessary resources, maybe I can go back with all my strength to Shadows of Kepler, because developing games is my big passion and it's what I've chosen for my life. 🚀

Thank you from my heart to everyone who supports me and gives me the strength to never give up.

notes.title: Shadows of Kepler team
notes.notes:
We are 4 guys who worked hard to bring a playable demo to GDC 2019 and find a partner to help us with the production. We tried a Kickstarter campaign, but it didn't work. Now our community is bigger and we plan to run an indiegogo campaign in the future. If you are not yet subscribed to our newsletter, register at www.shadowsofkepler.com to find out when the indiegogo campaign begins.

And check out our team and what we did with this game in the video:

[previewyoutube=s6cwQYAwymA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]




Rodrigo Banzato, the producer, is also developing by himself another game called Parallel, you could help us adding both games on your Steam Wishlist.

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello guys, let's take a look to the news.  Patch 1.0 is out.  Thanks for all the support.  As you may know, we are a very, very small team with Zero resources, but we're focused on hear your feedback which will help us a lot on the improvements for our game.

1 - When players get stuck behind the stairs (fixed)
2 - The fake death with the octopus corrupting your progress (fixed)
3 - Corrupt broken glass with the mutant (fixed)
4 - Improved the laser mode explosion of the enemies (its more flashy)
5 - You don't lose your items anymore on the card room
6 - You now can kill the radiation mutated with the right ammo and amount of shoots, and you don't stay stuck with a black screen when you die
7 - Fixed some texts and sounds
8 - The mutated on the embryo room don't hide anymore
9 - An invisible collision was corrected on the embryo room
10 - The collision on the left in the embryo room now is fixed

[i]We will keep working on the bugs and improvements. Thanks for playing the game and have fun.[/i]

Don't forget, if you like our game, support us on our [url=http://www.shadowsofkepler.com]Official Site[/url]
